# AirScope India

> Live air quality (AQI) for Delhi NCR: Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad. Readings come from official CPCB / DPCC / UPPCB / HSPCB monitoring stations (via data.gov.in and OpenAQ). Offline stations are clearly labelled and may show an atmospheric-model estimate.

## Data notes
- AQI follows the CPCB National AQI (NAQI) breakpoints.
- Readings update about every 15-60 minutes depending on the station.
- Not medical advice.
